title: Admission Process

steps.title: Choose Your Course
steps.text: Browse our programmes and select the course that matches your goals.

steps.title: Check Eligibility
steps.text: Review eligibility criteria on the course page or speak with our team.

steps.title: Submit Application
steps.text: Fill out the online application form with your details.

steps.title: Speak with Admissions
steps.text: Our counsellor will guide you on mode, schedule and fee options.

steps.title: Complete Formalities
steps.text: Submit documents and complete payment as advised.

steps.title: Begin Training
steps.text: Start your learning journey with SPEDICS!

documentsRequired: ID proof, educational certificates, passport-size photograph (details provided on application)
